migration_rules: Provisional numbers; integrator may renumber before a PR enters its train and freezes the number then.
Never take session-core 0044/0045. Every session-core migration ships revert/NNNN_*.down.sql and is additive.
Most Go services (not audit-core) re-run every *.up.sql at every boot with no ledger: write idempotent SQL. No third duplicate prefix.
proto_tags.proto_rules: Add-only; never renumber a wire field; record the 4.3 table as one append-only entry in MP/docs/decisions/ledger.md at T0 with the owner tag in a doc comment at each claimed field. buf breaking is not a real gate until WS12.S2.
proto_tags.reconcile: WS16 attention_unseen (derived from last_read_at) and WS17 unread (last_read_at) both kept; WS16 drops attention_seen_at from migration 0053 (DEC-11: unread = last_assistant_at > last_read_at).
